Garage floor jobs are big-ticket and seasonal. Leads often come from ads and your website, then go quiet if nobody calls back. These tools help you answer, book installs and invoice without a big office staff.

FAQ

What loses garage-floor leads?No clear next step on the site (photo upload or price-first estimate) and slow call-backs during installs. Fix the phone and the follow-up before you buy more ads.
Do I need full field service software?If you run more than a few jobs a week, Jobber or Housecall Pro pays for itself in fewer missed follow-ups. Solo operators can start with invoicing plus a cheap answering plan.
Cheapest starter kit?Wave (free) or Invoice Simple for invoices, plus Dialzara ($29/mo) or Rosie ($49/mo) for calls.
